motion.capture_method: wf-recorder -D (no-damage) ffv1, PTS from the compositor

checks.why: below 10 fps a 160 ms morph gets <2 samples
uneven spacing smears the time-aligned series
no travel means the morph never happened / wrong signal. UNRESOLVED when the panel merged with a dark window behind it
UNRESOLVED for wf-recorder: its PTS has no trustworthy wall-clock anchor. Relative pose timing remains measured.

checks.bound: <= 363 ms from command (anim 233 + 1 interval + slack), never-settled <= 1 trials
checks.why: UNRESOLVED for wf-recorder: command-relative settle would inherit the same invalid wall-clock offset. Use settle_duration_ms instead.

checks.bound: <= 363 ms of MOTION (anim 233 + 1 capture interval + 30 ms)
checks.why: the animation's own cost, independent of dispatch. UNRESOLVED whenever no intermediate geometry was captured: a 0.0 ms reading then means the sampler missed the motion, not that it was instantaneous. UNRESOLVED too when the capture interval exceeds a third of the morph: at that rate the reading is the sampler's, not the panel's
the easing is EaseOutCubic (src/main.rs:4835), which is monotone; a reversal is stutter or a re-triggered morph
EaseOutCubic does not overshoot by design, so anything past ~2 px (0.05 of 48 px travel) is quantisation noise or a bounce

checks.bound: >= 2 intermediate geometries in at least one trial
checks.why: below this the curve shape is not observable at all. UNRESOLVED too when the panel merged with a dark window behind it: the extent then belongs to the desktop, not the island

identical frames while a morph is in flight = animation not advancing. UNRESOLVED when no in-flight geometry was captured: at <60 fps the still frames before and after the morph dominate the ratio, so it grades the sampler, not the panel. UNRESOLVED too when no trial had an observed onset: the window would then be guesswork
wide ramp = soft/blurred capsule edges. UNRESOLVED with 0 measurable edges: that means the capsule overflowed the crop, not that it is sharp
edge softness must not be systematic

checks.bound: >= 8 distinct poses in the morph window (233 ms @ 60 Hz = 14.0 slots)
checks.why: THE smoothness number: distinct images presented while animating. 2-3 poses = the animation steps, one per display frame = smooth. UNRESOLVED when the window fell back to the whole burst: that count includes idle frames and cannot fail a paused-then-jump build
how long one pose is held; a hold longer than ~3 display intervals on a 233 ms morph is a visible step

checks.bound: >= 40 aligned samples in 5 x 10 ms bins
checks.why: without spread the morph curve is a single point
